blurb: Draughts is a comprehensive game featuring 16 international game variants, multiple AI difficulty levels, online multiplayer, and a modern interface.
description:
Draughts is a comprehensive game featuring 16 international game variants,
multiple AI difficulty levels, online multiplayer, and a modern interface.
It offers engaging gameplay for players of all skill levels with support for local and
online matches against friends or AI.

Game Features:

• 16 international variants including American, Russian, Brazilian, and Frisian

• 10 AI difficulty levels from Beginner to Grandmaster

• Online multiplayer with quick match, private rooms, and session persistence

• Multiple board themes and piece styles

• Complete move history with undo/redo and PDN export

The game ensures a polished experience with sound effects, keyboard navigation,
high contrast modes, smooth animations, and game history replay. It also
includes comprehensive rules documentation for every variant and adaptive
board orientation.
